key_insight: Dogs Trust ranks for Staffy buying and price searches on charity authority and a Staffy breed guide that sells adoption, not puppies: the guide answers care questions (health, food, exercise, grooming, crate, temperament, training, children) in short expandable blocks under a carousel of Staffies to rehome, but names no health test, prices no dog and leaves the costs to the buyer's vet. BSUK can meet the same searches with a Staffy guide that answers those same questions and adds what Dogs Trust leaves out: the breed's named health tests, real litter prices and what owning one costs.
